name: Meta Gallatin

timeline.event: Building 1 shell and cooling looks complete, but construction equipment is still seen around cooling and building.
Building 1 is operational, based on a lack of construction activity around the shell and cooling equipment, and about 6 months passing after structural completion.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Gallatin: current power 87 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Gallatin is an operating AI data center in Gallatin, TN, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 87 MW today and 114 MW when finished.
